title: JARVIS model registry
description: The one list of AI models, prices, limits, capability flags, per-feature defaults, kill switches, provider data terms and JARVIS AI's commercial settings. Published signed at GET /v1/registry. It is public: it must never hold a key, a secret, a credential or any user data. See registry/README.md. Model lookup: an id a cloud provider reports is matched to the entry with the longest id contained in it (case-insensitive; on a tie the later entry wins), among entries whose prices are not null and that are not managed. That set is exactly the price list the app ships in src-tauri/src/ai/models.rs. Every other entry is matched by exact id.

version.description: Monotonic. Every publish must carry a version greater than the one already published; apps refuse a lower version than the copy they hold.

issued_at.description: When this version was written, UTC.

min_app_version.description: The oldest app version that may use this registry. An older app keeps the copy built into it.

features.description: For each feature, the model each provider uses when the user has not chosen one: provider id to model id. A provider that is absent has no default for that feature (the user picks the model, as for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible services, or the feature does not run on it).

chat_model_filter.description: Which ids from a provider's live model list are offered as chat models (commands/ai_choice.rs chat_models).

presets.description: The named Gemini chains of Settings (ai/mod.rs AiRouter::new). A null model means the workload picks it: the premium default for a premium request, the chat default otherwise.

managed.description: JARVIS AI (managed Bedrock through the JARVIS proxy): commercial settings and the proxy's models. Money is integer US$ micros (1000000 = US$1) billed to the user, unless the name says HKD.

paused.description: Kill switch: true stops every JARVIS AI request.

allowances_usd_micros.description: Monthly allowance, in US$ billed. Resets monthly, no rollover.

per_user_daily_cap.description: US$ micros billed per user per day (the day in daily_cap_time_zone).

global_daily_ceiling.description: The global daily ceiling is the number of active entitled users times the per-user daily cap.

budget_alert_percent.description: Percentages of the monthly Bedrock budget at which the founder is alerted.

budget_kill_percent.description: Percentage of the monthly Bedrock budget at which JARVIS AI is switched off.

workload_map.description: The managed model the proxy runs for each JARVIS AI workload.

fallback.description: The proxy's internal fallback when the primary model fails to open; the user sees JARVIS AI as one model.

modelId.description: A model id the app may put in a URL path or a request: letters, digits and . _ : / -, with no '..' (ai/registry/doc.rs is_safe_model_id).

outputTokens.description: An output cap in tokens. The maximum is at least ten times version 1's largest (ai/registry/doc.rs MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS).

contextTokens.description: A context window in tokens (ai/registry/doc.rs MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS).

optionalRate.description: US$ per 1M tokens; null when the provider lists no such rate.

wire.description: The request format. typesafe, minimax and whisper_cpp are beyond the seven formats the plan lists: they are the mail classifier, the speech service and the on-device speech model the app already uses.

base_url.description: Null where the user or the region decides it.

host_suffixes.description: An OpenAI-compatible base URL whose host ends in one of these is this provider (ai/compat.rs label).

model_id_suffixes.description: A model id ending in one of these belongs to this provider (ai/mail_policy.rs is_ollama_cloud_model).

data_terms.description: safe: email may be sent. needs_billing_confirmation: only after the user confirms paid billing. unknown: not checked; email is not sent today (the consent card is P06).

consent_copy_keys.description: Message keys for the consent card. P06 adds them to src/i18n/catalog.ts; they are not in the catalog yet. Null exactly when data_terms is safe.

setup.description: How the provider is offered in setup step 1 (components/ChooseAi.tsx). Null: not offered there.

model.description: optional: none means the feature default. required: the user must pick one.

model_id_pattern.description: A regular expression the ids from the provider's live list must match to be offered as chat models; null keeps all.

default_for.description: The features this provider must have a default for in features.

inference_geographies.description: Bedrock inference profile prefixes the app points at the saved region; global is never rewritten.

built_in_models.description: The Bedrock picker's built-in list, shown when AWS cannot be asked.

tool_capable_families.description: Local model families with native tool calling, for models outside the catalog.

id.description: A safe model id (modelId), in lower case.

kind.description: family: a price pattern for a model family, not a model a user can pick.

status.description: Kill switch per model. disabled: never used; deprecated: still works, the replacement is suggested.

managed.description: True for JARVIS AI's own models: priced for the proxy and never matched by the app's price lookup.

prices.description: Null: no price (a local model, which is free, or a service billed in other units).

tiers.description: Once a request's input exceeds above_input_tokens, the whole request is billed at that tier.

price_source.description: Where and when the prices were read.

context.description: Context window in tokens; null where the app does not record it.

max_output.description: The most output tokens (thinking included) one request may ask for; null where not recorded.

capabilities.description: What JARVIS uses with this model today, not everything the model can do: false can mean the app does not use the ability yet.

local.description: For a model run by Ollama on this Mac.

setup.description: Set for the models offered in one-click setup and approved for mail.

download.description: For a model file the app downloads; the hash is checked before use.

bedrock.description: For a managed model: where and how the proxy calls it.

invoke.description: The foundation model ARN or the inference profile id the proxy sends.

hold_text_with_tools.description: The model can leak tool-call markup into text (DeepSeek DSML); the proxy holds text in tool turns until the message ends.
